headline: Align Technology stock drops 5% following weaker-than-expected Q4 revenue forecast
summary: Shares of Align Technology fell 5% after the company issued a fourth-quarter revenue outlook that fell short of market expectations.
why: Align Technology designs medical devices, including clear aligners; its stock performance reflects discretionary medical and consumer health spending.

impacts.name: Align Technology, Inc.
impacts.why: Soft revenue guidance for the fourth quarter triggered selling among investors.

why_moved: A weaker-than-expected fourth-quarter revenue outlook led to an immediate drop in share prices.
